georeference.sourceFigure: Thesis Figure 2B, embedded image2.png native 955 x 1053 pixels

unmappedNotes: RCN W2 and NWW are not explicitly located in the thesis Figure 2B; no inferred alias was used.
Pedernales subsite names Hamilton/LT/unspecified could not be matched unambiguously to individual square symbols.
5747318 is Edge Spring in Hunt Table 2 while the chemistry export classifies a numeric label as a well; it remains unmapped pending identity review.
Other regional laboratory labels lack defensible coordinates in the available source set.

properties.label: Approximate Middle Trinity groundwater divide
properties.source: Thesis Figure 2A, attributed there to Hunt (2023b); digitized approximation, not original divide GIS
properties.uncertaintyNote: 300 m is a conservative display tolerance chosen for this digitization, not a measured confidence interval. The source divide is itself approximate and may move with groundwater conditions.
properties.method: Manual line tracing; Figure 2A affine registration through Figure 2B to five Table 2 well coordinates.

geology.label: Bedrock geology · Hunt 2023
geology.attribution: Hunt (2023), UT Austin Bureau of Economic Geology; Texas Data Repository (CC0)
geology.description: Original published bedrock GIS polygons; 3 m simplification for browser display. Mapped contacts describe surface bedrock, not necessarily a well’s screened aquifer. No extrapolation beyond source coverage.
geology.geometryRepairNote: Two published source polygons had self intersecting rings; standard make_valid repair was applied before simplification.
